name: PixelLoop
description: Decorative constellation loop with rounded-dot and 45-degree vector-stroke variants; the glyph pool includes the studio D and T initials.

ariaRequirements: The decorative container and all six glyphs are hidden from assistive technology.
The component never enters the tab order.

governance.note: The Primary Studio reference informed the compact modular format, while original 5x5 vector cell-grid artwork, round marks, row-aware choreography, and timing establish a distinct implementation. Supports one, two, or three rows of three glyph grids. Alpha while forced-colors and light/dark verification remain pending outside the supplied Storybook contexts.

size.description: Scales the glyphs and the equal space between them.

variant.description: Rounded dots or short, round-capped 45-degree strokes.

rows.description: Number of three-glyph rows in the animated field.

animate.description: Runs the six-frame loop. Disable for a deliberate static composition.

cycle.description: Renders a single glyph cell (one row, one column) that steps through the whole glyph pool one formation at a time. Ignores rows.

forbiddenUse: use it to communicate loading, progress, status, or instructions.
add labels or interaction to the glyphs.
replace the stepped rotation with smooth motion.
